about_short_description.short_description: Finary is a platform that allows everybody to track and manage their wealth online.

product.name: Portfolio Tracker
product.description: A platform feature that automatically aggregates and tracks all user assets across various accounts and asset types in one place.

product.name: Crypto Investment Platform
product.description: An integrated service allowing users to buy, schedule purchases, and invest in cryptocurrencies with options for staking and lending.

product.name: Life Insurance Investment
product.description: A life insurance product offering profiled management with access to diversified ETFs and low fees, designed for wealth optimization and tax advantages.

product.name: Finary Plus Subscription
product.description: A premium subscription service providing advanced portfolio insights, fee analysis, diversification scoring, dividend tracking, and financial simulation tools.

product.name: Finary Pro Subscription
product.description: An advanced subscription tier that includes all Finary Plus features plus the ability to connect and manage business accounts and entities.
